verses.pali: “Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa uppajjanti saṁyojanābhinivesavinibandhā”ti?
verses.english: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, do fetters, insistence, and shackles arise?”
“Our teachings are rooted in the Buddha. …”

verses.pali: “rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṁ upādāya, rūpaṁ abhinivissa uppajjanti saṁyojanābhinivesavinibandhā.
verses.english: “When form exists, because of grasping form and insisting on form, fetters, insistence, and shackles arise.

verses.pali: viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṁ upādāya, viññāṇaṁ abhinivissa uppajjanti saṁyojanābhinivesavinibandhā.
verses.english: consciousness exists, because of grasping consciousness and insisting on consciousness, fetters, insistence, and shackles arise.

verses.pali: api nu taṁ anupādāya uppajjeyyuṁ saṁyojanābhinivesavinibandhā”ti?
verses.english: “But by not grasping what’s impermanent, suffering, and perishable, would fetters, insistence, and shackles arise?”
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
